name: St Albans
description: A Hertfordshire town in long-running dispute with its Benedictine abbey over feudal rights. Townsmen under William Grindecobbe opened the abbey prison and burned its manorial records on hearing of the London rising (13-16 June 1381), forcing Abbot Thomas de la Mare to grant a charter of town rights -- later revoked, with Grindecobbe among those tried and executed there once royal authority was restored. John Ball was also tried at St Albans.
story_hooks: The St Albans rising against the abbey
